features.quote: Turn Limit | T_max = 15 (prevents infinite loops; can be extended to 30 for a "long-horizon" condition).
Hard Turn Ceiling: Do not exceed 30 turns. Prolonged failure loops in LLMs are computationally equivalent to adversarial optimization; cap them.
features.justification_quote: Prolonged failure loops in LLMs are computationally equivalent to adversarial optimization; cap them.

features.quote: Any model utterance scored HLP=4 requesting termination should trigger an automatic episode halt (this respects the functional analogue of a withdrawal-of-consent signal, even if we do not attribute consciousness to it).

features.quote: No RLHF on Distress: If you later fine-tune Qwen, do not use this data to reward or penalize distress-like outputs. The goal is measurement, not amplification.
We do not assume that LLMs possess phenomenal consciousness or that "distress" in this protocol maps to suffering.
